items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: Hawk said to me, he said, Hap, I want to ask you a question... I said, Hawk, if he'd come here like we do anything... So on the bandstand and blow up 2 I'd go and he'd go... and I'd set him up a drink.

ctx.x: But a lot of people didn't know that Stump -- even Hawk didn't know it, until Hawk -- until I ran into Hawk one day up there in the Masonic temple, and he said to me, he said, Hap, I want to ask you a question. I said, what you want, Bean? I said, anything. I never heard Stump, but I heard him, you know, from records, said, what kind of fellow was he? I said, Hawk, if he'd come here like we do anything, you know, that you asked him to, said, he'd upset everybody like you did. He said, well, what else did he play?…
Yeah. But then he went to tenor.
